summary.mo_desc: Common Control Channel Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Intelligent Access Congest Ctrl Switch
summary.meaning: Whether to enable the intelligent access congestion control function. When this parameter is set to ON(On), this function is enabled. The BSC dynamically adjusts the SDCCH access interval (location update) and initial uplink PS access interval to relieve network congestion. When this parameter is set to OFF(Off), this function is disabled.
summary.impact: Setting this parameter to ON(On) increases the SDCCH access interval (location update) and initial uplink PS access interval and decreases the SDCCH and uplink TBF congestion rates.
summary.kpi: CSSR / SDCCH (access delay); possible SDCCH drop

summary.mo_desc: Common Control Channel Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Intelligent Access Congest Ctrl Thres.
summary.meaning: Threshold for triggering intelligent access congestion control. This parameter is used to check the congestion status of the location update SDCCH or uplink initial PS access.
summary.impact: Setting this parameter to a small value decreases the SDCCH and uplink TBF congestion rates.
summary.kpi: CSSR / SDCCH (access delay); possible SDCCH drop

summary.mo_desc: Common Control Channel Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Intelligent Access Congest Ctrl Timer 1
summary.meaning:
Increased value for timer T3122. This parameter is used with "IntAcesCongCtrlThres" to dynamically specify the increase of the cell access interval. 
The BSC starts the timer specified by this parameter when an immediate assignment fails but this timer is not started. 
If the timer specified by this parameter has not expired, the increased T3122 value remains unchanged. 
If the timer specified by this parameter expires, the BSC stops the timer. If the congestion rate of SDCCH access (location update) or initial uplink PS access is greater than or equal to the value of "IntAcesCongCtrlThres" within the duration specified by the timer, the value of T3122 for SDCCH or PDCH access is incremented by 1. Otherwise, the increased T3122 value remains unchanged.
summary.impact: Setting this parameter to a small value decreases the SDCCH congestion rate and uplink TBF congestion rate, but increases the location update and uplink initial PS access intervals.
summary.kpi: CSSR / SDCCH (access delay); possible SDCCH drop

summary.mo_desc: Common Control Channel Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Intelligent Access Congest Ctrl Timer 2
summary.meaning:
Decreased value for timer T3122. This parameter is used with "IntAcesCongCtrlThres" to dynamically specify the decrease of the cell access interval. 
The BSC automatically starts the timer specified by this parameter when the timer specified by "IntAcesCongCtrlTimer1" starts. 
If the timer specified by this parameter has not expired, the decreased T3122 value remains unchanged. 
When the timer specified by this parameter expires, if the congestion rate of SDCCH access (location update) or initial uplink PS access is less than the value of "IntAcesCongCtrlThres" within the duration specified by this timer, the value of T3122 for SDCCH access or initial uplink PS access is decreased by 1. Otherwise, the decreased T3122 value remains unchanged. 
When the decreased T3122 value is 0, the BSC stops the timer specified by this parameter. Otherwise, the BSC restarts this timer.
summary.impact: Setting this parameter to a large value increases the location update interval and uplink initial PS access interval.
summary.kpi: CSSR / SDCCH (access delay); possible SDCCH drop

summary.mo_desc: Timer Parameters of Cell
summary.meaning:
Timer carried by the Wait Indication information element when the BSC sends an immediate assignment reject or DTM reject message to an MS.
After the MS receives the immediate assignment reject or DTM reject message, the MS does not reattempt to access the network until the timer expires.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a large value, an MS is difficult to access the network. If this parameter is set to a small value, the channel load increases and the network access rate for the MS decreases.
summary.kpi: CSSR / SDCCH (access delay); possible SDCCH drop

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Load Thld for Low Load VAMOS FR Demultiplexing
summary.meaning: Load threshold for triggering VAMOS FR channel demultiplexing due to low load in a common cell or in the overlaid or underlaid subcell of a concentric cell. VAMOS FR channel demultiplexing is triggered if the load in a common cell or in the overlaid or underlaid subcell of a concentric cell is less than the value of this parameter.
summary.impact: The smaller the value of this parameter, the later the BSC makes a decision on VAMOS FR channel demultiplexing in a common cell or in the overlaid or underlaid subcell of a concentric cell. This helps alleviate cell congestion but decreases the MOS and increases the call drop rate more significantly.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Load Thres. of Channel Demultiplex
summary.meaning: Load threshold for triggering VAMOS HR channel demultiplexing in a common cell or in a concentric cell. VAMOS HR channel demultiplexing is triggered only when the load of a common cell or concentric cell is less than the value of this parameter.
summary.impact: The smaller the value of this parameter, the later the VAMOS channel demultiplexing decision due to low cell load is made, the smaller the number of times for handovers due to low cell load, the heavier the VAMOS traffic in the cell, and the greater the network quality deterioration.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Load Thres. in Overlaid Subcell
summary.meaning: Load threshold for triggering VAMOS HR channel multiplexing in the overlaid subcell of a concentric cell. VAMOS HR channel multiplexing using an intra-cell handover is triggered only when the load of the overlaid subcell of a concentric cell is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter. VAMOS HR channel multiplexing using channel allocation is triggered only when the load of the overlaid subcell of a concentric cell is greater than or equal to the sum of this parameter and "VAMOSASSLOADOFT".
summary.impact: The larger the value of this parameter, the smaller the number of new candidate VAMOS calls in the overlaid subcell. This affects VAMOS traffic volume and network quality.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Channel Multiplex Load Thres.
summary.meaning: Load threshold for triggering VAMOS HR channel multiplexing in a common cell or in the underlaid subcell of a concentric cell. VAMOS HR channel multiplexing using an intra-cell handover is triggered only when the load in a common cell or in the underlaid subcell of a concentric cell is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter. VAMOS HR channel multiplexing using channel allocation is triggered only when the load in a common cell or in the underlaid subcell of a concentric cell is greater than or equal to the sum of this parameter and "VAMOSASSLOADOFT".
summary.impact: The smaller the value of this parameter, the earlier the channel multiplexing decision is made, the higher the VAMOS traffic volume and the lower the network quality.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: OL Load Threshold for VAMOS FR Multiplexing
summary.meaning: Load threshold for triggering VAMOS FR channel multiplexing in the overlaid subcell of a concentric cell. VAMOS FR channel multiplexing using an intra-cell handover is triggered only if the load in the overlaid subcell of a concentric cell is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter. VAMOS FR channel multiplexing using channel allocation is triggered only if the load in the overlaid subcell of a concentric cell is greater than or equal to the sum of this parameter and "VAMOSASSLOADOFT".
summary.impact: The smaller the value of this parameter, the earlier the BSC makes a decision on VAMOS FR channel multiplexing in the overlaid subcell of a concentric cell and the heavier the VAMOS FR traffic in the overlaid subcell. Therefore, setting this parameter to a small value helps alleviate cell congestion. Compared with VAMOS HR, VAMOS FR has the same theoretical capacity and a higher MOS. This improves user experience. However, the HQI decreases and the call drop rate increases. Therefore, increasing the proportion of VAMOS FR deteriorates the HQI and call drop rate.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Load Threshold for VAMOS FR Multiplexing
summary.meaning:
Load threshold for triggering VAMOS FR channel multiplexing in a common cell or in the underlaid subcell of a concentric cell. VAMOS FR channel multiplexing using an intra-cell handover is triggered only if the load in a common cell or in the underlaid subcell of a concentric cell is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter. 
VAMOS FR channel multiplexing using channel allocation is triggered only if the load in a common cell or in the underlaid subcell of a concentric cell is greater than or equal to the sum of this parameter and "VAMOSASSLOADOFT".
summary.impact: The smaller the value of this parameter, the earlier the BSC makes a decision on VAMOS FR channel multiplexing in a common cell or in the underlaid subcell of a concentric cell and the heavier the VAMOS FR traffic in the cell. Therefore, setting this parameter to a small value helps alleviate cell congestion. Compared with VAMOS HR, VAMOS FR has the same theoretical capacity and a higher MOS. This improves user experience. However, the high quality indicator (HQI) decreases and the call drop rate increases. Therefore, increasing the proportion of VAMOS FR deteriorates the HQI and call drop rate.

summary.mo_desc: GSM Cell at BSC
summary.pname: NCC
summary.meaning:
Network color code that is provided by the telecom operator. The NCC is used to identify networks from area to area. Unified NCC planning is adopted by operators in a country.
The BCC and the NCC form the BSIC.
summary.impact: None
summary.kpi: HO / identity (can cause HO fail & drop)

summary.mo_desc: GSM Cell at BSC
summary.pname: BCC
summary.meaning: Base station color code (BCC) of a cell, provided by the network planning department. It is used for differentiating the cells using the same BCCH frequency. A BCC and a network color code (NCC) compose a base station identity code (BSIC).
summary.impact: None
summary.kpi: HO / identity (can cause HO fail & drop)

summary.mo_desc: Cell Priority and EUTRAN System Information Parameters
summary.pname: RSRP Threshold for Fast FDD LTE Reselection
summary.meaning:
RSRP threshold for fast reselection from a GSM cell to an LTE FDD cell. The BSC sends a CHANNEL RELEASE message that carries the frequency of neighboring LTE cells only when the RSRP of the neighboring LTE cells is higher than this threshold. 
The mapping between the value of this parameter and the decibel value is as follows:
0: -140 dBm,
1: -139 dBm,
...,
63: -77dBm.
summary.impact: A larger value of this parameter indicates that it is more difficult for an MS to reselect to an LTE cell. A smaller value of this parameter indicates that an MS is more likely to perform ping-pong reselections.

summary.mo_desc: Cell Priority and EUTRAN System Information Parameters
summary.pname: RSRP Threshold for Fast TDD LTE Reselection
summary.meaning:
RSRP threshold for fast reselection from a GSM cell to an LTE TDD cell. The BSC sends the CHANNEL RELEASE message that carries the frequency of neighboring LTE cells only when the RSRP of the neighboring LTE cells is higher than this threshold. 
The mapping between the value of this parameter and the decibel value is as follows:
0: -140dBm,
1: -139dBm,
...,
63: -77dBm.
summary.impact: A larger value of this parameter indicates that it is more difficult for an MS to reselect to an LTE cell. A smaller value of this parameter indicates that an MS is more likely to perform ping-pong reselections.

summary.mo_desc: Cell-level SRVCC parameters
summary.pname: Config Based SRVCC Fast Reselect Switch
summary.meaning:
Whether to allow configuration-based SRVCC fast return to LTE when MSs do not support LTE measurement.
When this parameter is set to ON, if SRVCC MSs do not support LTE frequency measurement or the BSC fails to obtain the LTE measurement capabilities of SRVCC MSs, the BSC allows SRVCC MSs to fast return to an LTE cell based on the configured LTE frequencies.
When this parameter is set to OFF, the BSC does not allow SRVCC MSs to fast return to an LTE cell based on the configured LTE frequencies.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to ON, configuration-based fast return to LTE can be triggered when SRVCC MSs do not support LTE frequency measurement or the BSC fails to obtain the LTE measurement capabilities of SRVCC MSs, decreasing the duration when SRVCC MSs fast return to an LTE cell. If this parameter is set to OFF, network performance is not affected.

summary.mo_desc: Cell-level SRVCC parameters
summary.pname: SRVCC Fast Reselect Meas Optimize Switch
summary.meaning:
Whether to enable the optimization of the SRVCC fast return to LTE function. 
When this parameter is set to ON:
1. If MSs support LTE frequency measurement, measurement-based fast return to LTE is triggered, and the BSC includes LTE frequencies and measurement information in the MI based on the LTE measurement capabilities of MSs.
2. If MSs do not support LTE frequency measurement or the BSC fails to obtain the LTE measurement capabilities of MSs, the BSC determines whether to trigger configuration-based fast return to LTE according to the value of the "SRVCCRapidSelBaseCfgSw" parameter. 
When this parameter is set to OFF:
1. If the "DecodeCSFBInd" parameter in the "SET AITFOTHPARA" command is set to ON(On) and the CSFB Indication IE is not carried in the Clear Command message or the value of this IE is 0, the BSC does not send the fast return message.
2. If the "DecodeCSFBInd" parameter in the "SET AITFOTHPARA" command is set to OFF(Off) or the value of the CSFB Indication IE carried in the Clear Command message is 1, the BSC sends the fast return messages to MSs based on the LTE frequency measurement results of MSs when the "FASTRETURNMEASSPT" parameter in the "SET GCELLPRIEUTRANSYS" command is set to ON(On), or sends the fast return messages to MSs based on the LTE frequencies for which the "SPTRAPIDSEL" parameter in the "ADD GLTENCELL" or "MOD GLTENCELL" command is set to SUPPORT when the "FASTRETURNMEASSPT" parameter in the "SET GCELLPRIEUTRANSYS" command is set to OFF(Off).
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to ON, the BSC sends more accurate LTE frequencies to MSs based on MS capabilities, and MSs measure LTE frequencies more accurately and return to an LTE cell more quickly. If this parameter is set to OFF, network performance is not affected.

summary.mo_desc: Basic Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Concentric Intelligent Shutdown Switch
summary.meaning: Whether to enable the intelligent power saving optimization function in a concentric cell. When this parameter is set to ON, power amplifier of the TRX serving the overlaid subcell is shut down when the cell traffic is light; the traffic will be carried by the TRX serving the underlaid subcell to obtain maximum power saving gains. When this parameter is set to OFF, power amplifier of the TRX serving the overlaid subcell is shut down only when all traffic of the overlaid subcell is released.
summary.impact: Setting this parameter to ON increases traffic carried by the underlaid subcell.

summary.mo_desc: Basic Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Allow Dynamic Shutdown of TRX
summary.meaning: This parameter specifies whether to allow the BSC to enable the TRX Intelligent Shutdown feature on a cell.
summary.impact: None

summary.mo_desc: Basic Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Energy Conserve Prefer Switch
summary.meaning: Whether the BSC preferentially allocates channels on a power amplifier-enabled TRX when an MS attempts to perform voice services. If this parameter is set to ON, within the power saving period specified in the "SET BSCDSTPA" command, power saving takes precedence over capacity and quality during channel allocation, and the BSC preferentially allocates channels on a power amplifier-enabled TRX during a call access or handover. If this parameter is set to OFF, the BSC does not preferentially allocate channels on a power amplifier-enabled TRX; instead, it allocates channels based on the policy specified by the "CHALLOCSTRATEGY" parameter in the "SET GCELLCHMGBASIC" command.
summary.impact: None

summary.mo_desc: Basic Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: PDCH TRX Intelligent Shutdown Switch
summary.meaning: Whether to allow shutdown of TRXs with PDCHs in the TRX Power Amplifier Intelligent Shutdown feature. When this parameter is set to ENABLED, users can set "CPS" in "SET GTRXDEV" to YES for TRXs with static PDCHs, and TRXs with PDCHs support intelligent power amplifier shutdown. When this parameter is set to DISABLED, users cannot set "CPS" in "SET GTRXDEV" to YES for TRXs with static PDCHs, and TRXs with PDCHs do not support intelligent power amplifier shutdown.
summary.impact: Enabling this function helps conserve power but decreases PS capacity.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Allow HO Multiplex Before CONNECT ACK
summary.meaning:
Whether to allow VAMOS multiplexing for an MS that has not received a Connect ACK message. 
When this parameter is set to ON, VAMOS multiplexing is allowed for such an MS.
When this parameter is set to OFF, VAMOS multiplexing is not allowed for such an MS.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to OFF, the VAMOS multiplexing rate decreases. If this parameter is set to ON, the call drop rate after VAMOS multiplexing increases.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Mute SAIC Terminal Processing Switch
summary.meaning: Whether to enable the function for processing mute SAIC-capable MSs in a cell. A mute SAIC-capable MS is a SAIC-capable MS that is reported as SAIC-incapable. The value ON indicates that the function for processing such MSs is enabled; the value OFF indicates that the function for processing such MSs is disabled. Processing mute SAIC-capable MSs consists of identification of such MSs based on database records and automatic identification of such MSs.
summary.impact: When this parameter is set to ON, IMEI identification is performed before the BSC assigns a TCH, delaying call access.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Problem SAIC Terminal Processing Switch
summary.meaning: Whether to enable the function for processing SAIC-capable MSs with AFC defects in a cell. The value ON indicates that the function for processing such MSs is enabled; the value OFF indicates that the function for processing such MSs is disabled. Processing SAIC-capable MSs with AFC defects consists of identification of such MSs based on database records and automatic identification of such MSs.
summary.impact: When this parameter is set to ON, IMEI identification is performed before the BSC assigns the TCH, delaying call access.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: DL Rx Qual. Thres. of Established Calls
summary.meaning:
Threshold of the downlink receive quality of an established call to be selected as a candidate VAMOS call. The decision on this call can be triggered successfully only when the following conditions are met: 1. The ATCB of this call is greater than or equal to the ATCB threshold. 2. The uplink receive quality is smaller than or equal to "VamosIntraHoUlQualThd". 3. The downlink receive quality is smaller than or equal to the value of this parameter. 4. The uplink receive level is greater than or equal to "VamosIntraHoUlRxlevThd". 5. The downlink receive level is greater than or equal to "VamosIntraHoDlRxlevThd". 6. The absolute value of the difference between main and diversity receive levels is less than or equal to "VamosAntUlRxlevDiffThd".
If the decision conditions are met for "VamosOldCallLastTimes" within "VamosOldCallStatTimes", this call can be selected as a candidate VAMOS call. Otherwise, this call cannot be selected as a candidate VAMOS call.
summary.impact: The smaller the value of this parameter, the smaller the number of accessed candidate VAMOS calls. As a result, VAMOS traffic volume decreases and network quality deteriorates slightly.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: DL Rx Lev. Thres. of VAMOS Calls
summary.meaning:
Threshold of the downlink receive level of an established call to be selected as a candidate VAMOS call. VAMOS is short for voice services over adaptive multi-user channels on one slot. The decision on an established call can be triggered successfully only when both of the following conditions are met: 1. The downlink receive level of an established call is greater than or equal to this threshold. 2. The uplink and downlink receive quality, uplink and downlink receive levels, ATCB, and absolute value of the difference between main and diversity receive levels meet relevant requirements. 
If the decision conditions are met for "VamosOldCallLastTimes" within "VamosOldCallStatTimes", this call can be selected as a candidate VAMOS call. Otherwise, this call cannot be selected as a candidate VAMOS call.
summary.impact: The larger the value of this parameter, the smaller the number of new candidate VAMOS calls. This affects VAMOS traffic volume and network quality.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: UL Rx Qual. Thres. of Established Calls
summary.meaning:
Threshold of the uplink receive quality of an established call to be selected as a candidate VAMOS call. The decision on this call can be triggered successfully only when all of the following conditions are met: 1. The ATCB of this call is greater than or equal to the ATCB threshold. 2. The uplink receive quality is smaller than or equal to the value of this parameter. 3. The downlink receive quality is smaller than or equal to "VamosIntraHoDlQualThd". 4. The uplink receive level is greater than or equal to "VamosIntraHoUlRxlevThd". 5. The downlink receive level is greater than or equal to "VamosIntraHoDlRxlevThd". 6. The absolute value of the difference between main and diversity receive levels is less than or equal to "VamosAntUlRxlevDiffThd".
If the decision conditions are met for "VamosOldCallLastTimes" within "VamosOldCallStatTimes", this call can be selected as a candidate VAMOS call. Otherwise, this call cannot be selected as a candidate VAMOS call.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a small value, the number of established calls that can be selected as VAMOS candidate calls decreases, the VAMOS traffic volume in the cell decreases, and the deterioration of network quality eases.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: UL RX Level Thld for Channel Multiplexing
summary.meaning: Uplink receive level threshold for a call that has accessed a cell to serve as a candidate VAMOS call. This parameter works with "VamosAssDlRxlevThdOffset", "VAMOSOLRXLEVOFT", and "VFRRxlevOffset" to specify the uplink receive level standard of a candidate VAMOS call. An accessed call whose uplink receive level fails to meet the standard cannot serve as a candidate VAMOS call. The preceding rule is invalid if this parameter is set to 0.
summary.impact: The larger the value of this parameter, the higher the required uplink receive level of a candidate VAMOS call, the less the candidate VAMOS calls, and the lower the VAMOS traffic volume.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Allow VAMOS-1&NonSAIC and SAIC&NonSAIC
summary.meaning: Whether to allow the multiplexing of a VAMOS-1 call and a non-SAIC call and the multiplexing of a SAIC call and a non-SAIC call. The value ON indicates that the two types of multiplexing are allowed; the value OFF indicates that the two types of multiplexing are not allowed.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to ON(On), the VAMOS channel multiplexing rate and network capacity  increase. However, network quality deteriorates noticeably after the preceding pairs of calls are multiplexed because of poor link performance.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: DL RX Level Thd of Terminal Identify
summary.meaning: Threshold of downlink receive level for triggering automatic identification of mute SAIC MSs and problem SAIC MSs. When the downlink receive level of a call is lower than the value of this parameter, automatic identification of such MSs is not performed. The preceding rule is invalid if this parameter is set to 0.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a larger value, the required downlink receive level for triggering automatic identification is larger. Therefore, automatic identification is performed on fewer calls in the network. As a result, fewer calls are affected and network quality decreases at a slower rate. However, the automatic identification efficiency is lower.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: LO Thresh upon Terminal Identify Request
summary.meaning: Load threshold for performing automatic identification of mute SAIC-capable MSs, SAIC-capable MSs with AFC defects, and SAIC white MSs in a cell. MS identification request is triggered only when cell load is lower than or equal to the value of this parameter.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a large value, mute SAIC terminal identification is triggered in a cell with high load. The number of automatic identification decisions made by MSs increases and network quality deteriorates seriously.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Max Calls in Terminal Identification
summary.meaning: Maximum number of calls in a cell, on which identification of mute SAIC-capable MSs, identification of SAIC-capable MSs with AFC defects, and identification of SAIC white MSs can be performed simultaneously.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a large value, automatic mute SAIC terminal identification and problem SAIC terminal identification can be performed simultaneously on more calls in a cell. Therefore, the number of calls affected by the identification process increases and network quality deteriorates seriously.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: UL RX Level Thd of Terminal Identify
summary.meaning: Threshold of uplink receive level for triggering automatic identification of mute SAIC MSs and problem SAIC MSs. When the uplink receive level of a call is lower than the value of this parameter, automatic identification of such MSs is not performed. The preceding rule is invalid if this parameter is set to 0.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a larger value, the required uplink receive level for triggering automatic identification is larger. Therefore, automatic identification is performed on fewer calls in the network. As a result, fewer calls are affected and network quality decreases at a slower rate. However, the automatic identification efficiency is lower.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Channel Multiplex Rx Qual. Thres. Offset in Asgmt.
summary.meaning: Offset of the uplink or downlink receive quality of a new call against the quality threshold of existing calls. If a new call is to be selected as a candidate call for VAMOS channel multiplexing during channel assignment, its uplink receive quality must be smaller than or equal to "VamosIntraHoUlQualThd" minus "VamosAssUlQualThdOffset" and its downlink receive quality must be smaller than or equal to "VamosIntraHoDlQualThd" minus "VamosAssUlQualThdOffset".
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a large value, the number of new calls as VAMOS candidate calls decreases, the VAMOS traffic volume in the cell decreases, and the deterioration of network quality eases. If this parameter is set to a small value, the number of new calls as VAMOS candidate calls increases, the VAMOS traffic volume in the cell increases, and the deterioration of network quality increases.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Enable BQ VAMOS Channel Demultiplex Penalty
summary.meaning: Whether to enable the BQ VAMOS demultiplexing penalty function. If this parameter is set to ON, the BSC, after performing VAMOS channel demultiplexing due to BQ on a pair of multiplexed calls, performs penalty on the call with poorer quality. In this case, the BSC forbids VAMOS channel multiplexing on the call. If this parameter is set to OFF, the BSC does not perform penalty on the call with poorer quality.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to ON, the call drop rate decreases, but the VAMOS traffic volume also decreases.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Primary TSC in VAMOS
summary.meaning: Primary Training Sequence Code (TSC) used in the network when the VAMOS function is enabled in a cell. Before all calls enter the VAMOS mode, the primary TSC is assigned preferentially; after a pair of VAMOS calls is multiplexed, the TSC that is not used by the call that accesses the timeslot first is assigned to the other call.
summary.impact: None

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Secondary TSC in VAMOS
summary.meaning: Secondary Training Sequence Code (TSC) used in the network when the VAMOS function is enabled in a cell. Before all calls enter the VAMOS mode, the primary TSC is assigned preferentially; after a pair of VAMOS calls is multiplexed, the TSC that is not used by the call that accesses the timeslot first is assigned to the other call.
summary.impact: None

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Opt VAMOS Channel Multiplexing Alg Allowed
summary.meaning: Whether to use the optimized VAMOS channel multiplexing algorithm. When this parameter is set to YES, all MSs in the candidate VAMOS call queue are sorted in ascending order of receive quality of established candidate calls. MSs with the same receive quality are sorted in descending order of ATCB. When this parameter is set to NO, all MSs in the candidate VAMOS call queue are sorted in ascending order of path loss of established candidate calls.
summary.impact: When this parameter is set to YES, the speech quality does not deteriorate or improves. This algorithm will significantly improve the speech quality if the VAMOS and IBCA functions are enabled together.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: SAIC White MS Identification Switch
summary.meaning: Whether to enable the SAIC white MS identification function. An SAIC white MS refers to a SAIC MS that supports Alpha-QPSK modulation. If this parameter is set to ON, this function is enabled, and the BSC identifies SAIC white MSs and can use Alpha-QPSK modulation on the multiplexed SAIC white MSs in the downlink. If this parameter is set to OFF, this function is disabled.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to ON, the BSC identifies SAIC white MSs, the VAMOS multiplexing performance improves, but the call drop rate increases and the voice quality deteriorates.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: ATCB Thres of Terminal Identify
summary.meaning: ATCB threshold of a call for triggering automatic MS identification. When the ATCB of a call is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter, automatic identification of mute SAIC-capable MSs and SAIC-capable MSs with AFC defects is performed. The actual value of this parameter equals the GUI value minus 64.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a large value, the ATCB of a call in terminal identification request is high, and terminal identification can be performed on few calls. This eases network quality deterioration.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: DL RX Qual Thres of Terminal Identify
summary.meaning: Threshold of the downlink receive quality of a call for triggering automatic MS identification.When the downlink receive quality of a call is greater than the value of this parameter, automatic identification of such MSs is not performed. When the downlink receive quality of a call is lower than or equal to the value of this parameter, automatic identification of such MSs is performed.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a small value, automatic mute SAIC terminal identification is performed on calls with favorable downlink receive quality. Therefore, automatic mute SAIC terminal identification is performed on few calls in the network. As a result, few calls are affected and network quality decreases slightly.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Satisfy Time for Terminal Identify
summary.meaning: Duration in which uplink and downlink quality, uplink and downlink levels, and ATCB of a call meet the thresholds. If the duration in which uplink and downlink quality,uplink and downlink levels, and ATCB of a call meet the thresholds within the time specified by "SpeMsIdeStatTimes" is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter, MS identification is allowed to be triggered.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a large value, a longer period of observing uplink and downlink call quality and ATCB for triggering automatic identification is required. In this case, the BSC triggers MS identification at a later time, thereby decreasing the number of calls on which MS identification can be performed on the network. As a result, the number of calls affected by MS identification decreases, and network quality deteriorates more slightly.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Watch Time for Terminal Identify
summary.meaning: Observation period for uplink and downlink quality, uplink and downlink levels, ATCB of a call. If the duration in which uplink and downlink quality,uplink and downlink levels, and ATCB of a call meet the thresholds within the time specified by this parameter is greater than or equal to the value of "SpeMsIdeLastTimes", MS identification is allowed to be triggered.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a large value, a long period for observing uplink and downlink call quality and ATCB is required. Therefore, automatic terminal identification is triggered late and few calls are affected, which deteriorates network quality slightly.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: UL RX Qual Thres of Terminal Identify
summary.meaning: Threshold of the uplink receive quality of a call for triggering automatic identification of mute SAIC-capable MSs and SAIC-capable MSs with AFC defects. When the uplink receive quality of a call is greater than the value of this parameter, automatic identification of such MSs is not performed. When the uplink receive quality of a call is lower than or equal to the value of this parameter, automatic identification of such MSs is performed.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a small value, automatic mute SAIC terminal identification is performed on calls with favorable uplink receive quality. Therefore, automatic mute SAIC terminal identification is performed on few calls in the network. As a result, few calls are affected and network quality deteriorates less.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Main and Diversity UL RX Level Diff Thld for MUX
summary.meaning: Uplink main and diversity receive level difference threshold for candidate VAMOS call decision. If the main and diversity receive level difference after measurement report filtering is greater than the value of this parameter, VAMOS multiplexing is not allowed. The preceding rule is invalid if this parameter is set to 127.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to an overly large value, calls with overly large main and diversity receive level differences can receive VAMOS multiplexing. As a result, the uplink HQIs and call drop rate deteriorate. If this parameter is set to an overly small value, calls with proper main and diversity receive level differences cannot receive VAMOS multiplexing. As a result, the VAMOS traffic volume decreases and network congestion becomes more severe.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Rx Lev. Thres. Offset During Assignment
summary.meaning: Offset of the downlink receive level of a new call from the level threshold of established calls if the new call is to be selected as a VAMOS candidate call during assignment. A new call can be selected as a VAMOS candidate call only when the following conditions are met: The downlink receive level of the new call is greater than or equal to the sum of DL Rx Lev. Thres. of VAMOS Calls and this parameter. The uplink and downlink receive quality as well as the ATCB meet relevant requirements.
summary.impact: The larger the value of this parameter, the smaller the number of new candidate VAMOS calls. This affects VAMOS traffic volume and network quality.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Multiplexing Load Thres. Offset in Assignment
summary.meaning: Offset between the load threshold and the handover multiplexing load threshold for VAMOS channel multiplexing during assignment. When VAMOS channel multiplexing during assignment is enabled in common cells and underlaid subcells in concentric cells, the decision procedure for VAMOS channel multiplexing during assignment is triggered if the cell load or load in the underlaid subcell is higher than or equal to the sum of "VamosMultLoadThd" and "VAMOSASSLOADOFT". When VAMOS channel multiplexing during assignment is enabled in overlaid subcells, the decision procedure for VAMOS channel multiplexing during assignment is triggered if the load in the overlaid subcell is higher than or equal to the sum of "VamosIuoInnerLoadThd" and "VAMOSASSLOADOFT". The actual value for this parameter is the GUI value for this parameter minus 100.
summary.impact: The smaller the value of this parameter, the lower the load start threshold required by VAMOS channel multiplexing during assignment, the earlier the VAMOS channel multiplexing during assignment is triggered.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Channel Multiplex ATCB Thres. Offset in Asgmt.
summary.meaning: Offset of the ATCB for a new call from the ATCB threshold for existing calls, if the new call is to be selected as a candidate VAMOS HR call during channel allocation. If the new call is a Non-SAIC call in a common cell or in the underlaid subcell of a concentric cell, the ATCB for the new call must be greater than or equal to the sum of the values of "VamosIntraHoNoneSaicAtcbThd" and "VamosAssMultAtcbOffset". If the new call is a Non-SAIC call in the overlaid subcell of a concentric cell, the ATCB for the new call must be greater than or equal to the sum of "VamosIntraHoNoneSaicAtcbThd", "VamosAssMultAtcbOffset", and "VamosIuoInnerAtcbThd". The preceding rules apply to SAIC calls, VAMOS I calls, and VAMOS II calls that are newly set up.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a large value, the number of new calls as VAMOS candidate calls decreases, the VAMOS traffic volume in the cell decreases, and the deterioration of network quality eases.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Allow Channel Multiplex in Assignment
summary.meaning: Whether to enable VAMOS channel multiplexing during assignment in the network. The value ON indicates that VAMOS channel multiplexing during assignment is enabled in a cell; the value OFF indicates that VAMOS channel multiplexing during assignment is disabled in a cell.
summary.impact: When "VamosSwitch" is set to ON, VFR, or VHR and "VamosAssSwitch" is set to ON, the network congestion rate decreases significantly; however, network quality decreases after VAMOS calls are multiplexed.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: OL BQ Demultiplexing Rx Quality Thres. Offset
summary.meaning:
Receive signal quality threshold offset between a VAMOS call in the overlaid subcell and a VAMOS call in the underlaid subcell during channel demultiplexing due to bad quality. VAMOS channel demultiplexing due to bad quality is triggered if the P/N criterion is met and either of the following conditions is met:
The uplink receive signal quality of the VAMOS call in the overlaid subcell is higher than or equal to "VamosQualReuseUpLinkQualThd" minus "VAMOSDEPOLRXQUALOFT". The downlink receive signal quality of the VAMOS call in the overlaid subcell is higher than or equal to "VamosQualReuseDownLinkQualThd" minus "VAMOSDEPOLRXQUALOFT". 
The actual value for this parameter is the GUI value for this parameter minus 70.
summary.impact:
The smaller the value of this parameter:
The smaller the receive signal quality offset between a VAMOS call in the overlaid subcell and a VAMOS call in the underlaid subcell during channel demultiplexing due to bad quality
The later the channel demultiplexing due to bad quality is triggered
The more the VAMOS traffic volume
The lower the network quality.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: VAMOS FACCH Send Enhance Switch
summary.meaning: Whether to enable the VAMOS FACCH send enhance function. Setting this parameter to ON automatically converts Alpha-QPSK modulation to GMSK modulation for the FACCH when the quality of the radio environment is poor. Therefore, downlink FACCH demodulation performance can be improved significantly.
summary.impact: Setting this parameter to ON decreases the VAMOS call drop rate but may also slightly decrease the MOS of multiplexed calls.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: ATCB Thres. of Established Non-SAIC Calls
summary.meaning: ATCB threshold of an established non-SAIC call to be selected as a candidate call for VAMOS channel multiplexing. The decision on an established Non-SAIC call can be triggered successfully only when the following conditions are met: The ATCB of the call is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter. The uplink receive quality is lower than or equal to "UL Rx Qual. Thres. of Established Calls". The downlink receive quality is lower than or equal to "DL Rx Qual. Thres. of Established Calls". If the decision conditions are met for "Duration of Satisfying Candidate VAMOS Call" within "Watch Time of Candidate Calls", this call can be selected as a VAMOS candidate call. The actual value of this parameter equals the GUI value minus 64.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a large value, the number of established Non-SAIC calls that can be selected as VAMOS candidate calls decreases, the VAMOS traffic volume in the cell decreases, and the deterioration of network quality eases.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: ATCB Thres. of Established SAIC Calls
summary.meaning:
ATCB threshold of an established SAIC call to be selected as a candidate call for VAMOS channel multiplexing. The decision on an established SAIC call can be triggered successfully only when all of the following conditions are met: 1. The ATCB of the call is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter. 2. The uplink receive quality is smaller than or equal to "VamosIntraHoUlQualThd". 3. The downlink receive quality is smaller than or equal to "VamosIntraHoDlQualThd". 
4. The uplink receive level is greater than or equal to "VamosIntraHoUlRxlevThd". 5. The downlink receive level is greater than or equal to "VamosIntraHoDlRxlevThd". 6. The absolute value of the difference between main and diversity receive levels is less than or equal to "VamosAntUlRxlevDiffThd".
If the decision conditions are met for "VamosOldCallLastTimes" within "VamosOldCallStatTimes", this call can be selected as a candidate VAMOS call. Otherwise, this call cannot be selected as a candidate VAMOS call. The actual value of this parameter equals the GUI value minus 64.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a large value, the number of established SAIC calls that can be selected as VAMOS candidate calls decreases, the VAMOS traffic volume in the cell decreases, and the deterioration of network quality eases.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Allow Channel Multiplex via In-Cell HO
summary.meaning: Whether to enable VAMOS channel multiplexing through intra-cell handover in the network. The value ON indicates that VAMOS channel multiplexing through intra-cell handover is enabled in a cell; the value OFF indicates that VAMOS channel multiplexing through intra-cell handover is disabled in a cell.
summary.impact: When "VamosSwitch" is set to ON, VFR, or VHR and "VamosAssSwitch" is set to ON, the network congestion rate decreases significantly; however, network quality decreases after VAMOS calls are multiplexed.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: ATCB Thres. of Established VAMOS-1 Calls
summary.meaning:
ATCB threshold of an established VAMOS-1 call to be selected as a candidate call for VAMOS HR channel multiplexing. The decision on an established VAMOS-1 call can be triggered successfully only when all of the following conditions are met: 1. The ATCB of the call is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter. 2. The uplink receive quality is smaller than or equal to "VamosIntraHoUlQualThd". 3. The downlink receive quality is smaller than or equal to "VamosIntraHoDlQualThd". 
4. The uplink receive level is greater than or equal to "VamosIntraHoUlRxlevThd". 5. The downlink receive level is greater than or equal to "VamosIntraHoDlRxlevThd". 6. The absolute value of the difference between main and diversity receive levels is less than or equal to "VamosAntUlRxlevDiffThd".
If the decision conditions are met for "VamosOldCallLastTimes" within "VamosOldCallStatTimes", this call can be selected as a candidate VAMOS call. Otherwise, this call cannot be selected as a candidate VAMOS call. The actual value of this parameter equals the GUI value minus 64.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a large value, the number of established VAMOS-1 calls that can be selected as VAMOS candidate calls decreases, the VAMOS traffic volume in the cell decreases, and the deterioration of network quality eases.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: ATCB Thres. of Established VAMOS-2 Calls
summary.meaning:
ATCB threshold of an established VAMOS-2 call to be selected as a candidate call for VAMOS channel multiplexing. The decision on an established VAMOS-2 call can be triggered successfully only when all of the following conditions are met: 1. The ATCB of the call is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter. 2. The uplink receive quality is smaller than or equal to "VamosIntraHoUlQualThd". 3. The downlink receive quality is smaller than or equal to "VamosIntraHoDlQualThd". 
4. The uplink receive level is greater than or equal to "VamosIntraHoUlRxlevThd". 5. The downlink receive level is greater than or equal to "VamosIntraHoDlRxlevThd". 6. The absolute value of the difference between main and diversity receive levels is less than or equal to "VamosAntUlRxlevDiffThd".
If the decision conditions are met for "VamosOldCallLastTimes" within "VamosOldCallStatTimes", this call can be selected as a candidate VAMOS call. Otherwise, this call cannot be selected as a candidate VAMOS call. The actual value of this parameter equals the GUI value minus 64.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a large value, the number of established VAMOS-2 calls that can be selected as VAMOS candidate calls decreases, the VAMOS traffic volume in the cell decreases, and the deterioration of network quality eases.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: ATCB Offset in Overlaid Subcell
summary.meaning: Offset of the ATCB of a new call in the overlaid subcell from the ATCB threshold of a new call in the underlaid subcell if the new call in the overlaid subcell is to be selected as a VAMOS candidate call during assignment.
summary.impact: The larger the value of this parameter, the smaller the number of new candidate VAMOS calls in the overlaid subcell. This affects VAMOS traffic volume and network quality.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Channel Demultiplex on Low Cell Load
summary.meaning: Whether to enable VAMOS channel demultiplexing when the load in a cell is low. The value ON indicates that VAMOS channel demultiplexing due to low cell load is enabled; the value OFF indicates that VAMOS channel demultiplexing due to low cell load is disabled.
summary.impact: When this parameter is set to ON and "VamosSwitch" is set to ON, VFR, or VHR, KPIs related to network quality improve.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: MS Support VAMOS I&II Enable
summary.meaning: Whether to support VAMOS I and II MSs. The VAMOS performance of VAMOS I and VAMOS II MSs is better than that of SAIC-capable MSs. If this parameter is set to ON, the BSS supports VAMOS I and VAMOS II MSs.
summary.impact: Setting this parameter to ON can improve the VAMOS performance of a network.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: VAMOS No DL MR Handover Optimize Switch
summary.meaning: Whether to optimize handovers due to no downlink measurement report (MR) for VAMOS calls. If this parameter is set to ON, the BSC preferentially performs handovers due to no downlink MR in a cell for VAMOS calls when the conditions for performing handovers due to no downlink MR are met. In addition, such handovers are not controlled by [GCELLHOEMG:NODLMRHOEN] and [GCELLHOBASIC:INTRACELLHOEN]. If this parameter is set to OFF, the BSC does not optimize handovers due to no downlink MR for VAMOS calls, and such handovers are controlled by [GCELLHOEMG:NODLMRHOEN].
summary.impact: None

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Duration of Satisfying Candidate VAMOS Call
summary.meaning: Duration within which a call satisfies the decision conditions for selecting a VAMOS candidate call. If the decision conditions are met for "Duration of Satisfying Candidate VAMOS Call" within "Watch Time of Candidate Calls". Otherwise, this call can be selected as a VAMOS candidate call.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a large value, the decision of accepting a call as a VAMOS candidate call is triggered late, and the number of calls that can be selected as VAMOS candidate calls decreases. These affect the number of VAMOS candidate calls and timeliness of VAMOS channel multiplexing.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Watch Time of Candidate Calls
summary.meaning: Duration within which the ATCB and receive quality of a call are observed to determine whether this call can be selected as a VAMOS candidate call. If the decision is triggered for "Duration of Satisfying Candidate VAMOS Call" within the period of time specified by this parameter. Otherwise, this call can be selected as a VAMOS candidate call.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a large value, the decision of accepting a call as a VAMOS candidate call is triggered late, and the number of calls that can be selected as VAMOS candidate calls decreases. These affect the number of VAMOS candidate calls and timeliness of VAMOS channel multiplexing.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: OL Multiplexing Rx Level Thres. Offset
summary.meaning:
Receive level threshold offset between a call in the overlaid subcell and a call in the underlaid subcell when a call is selected as the candidate VAMOS call during channel multiplexing in the overlaid subcell. A new call in the overlaid subcell is selected as the candidate VAMOS call if all of the following conditions are met: 1. The downlink receive level of the new call is greater than or equal to the sum of "VamosIntraHoDlRxlevThd", "VamosAssDlRxlevThdOffset" and "VAMOSOLRXLEVOFT". 2. The uplink receive level of the new call is greater than or equal to the sum of "VamosIntraHoUlRxlevThd", "VamosAssDlRxlevThdOffset", and "VAMOSOLRXLEVOFT". 3. The uplink and downlink receive quality, ATCB, absolute value of the difference between main and diversity receive levels, and P/N criterion meets relevant requirements. 
An established call in the overlaid subcell is selected as the candidate VAMOS call if both of the following conditions are met: 1. The downlink receive level of the established call is greater than or equal to the sum of "VamosIntraHoDlRxlevThd" and "VAMOSOLRXLEVOFT". 2. The uplink and downlink receive quality, ATCB, absolute value of the difference between main and diversity receive levels, and P/N criterion meets relevant requirements.
The actual value for this parameter is the GUI value for this parameter minus 128.
summary.impact:
The smaller the value of this parameter:
The smaller the receive signal level offset between a call in the overlaid subcell that regards as the candidate VAMOS call and a call in the underlaid subcell that regards as the candidate VAMOS call
The looser the conditions for selecting a call as the candidate VAMOS call
The more the VAMOS traffic volume
The lower the network quality.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: OL Multiplexing Rx Quality Thres. Offset
summary.meaning:
Receive quality offset between a call in the overlaid subcell and a call in the underlaid subcell when decisions on candidate VAMOS calls are made during VAMOS channel multiplexing in the overlaid subcell. A new call in the overlaid subcell can be used as the candidate VAMOS call if all of the following conditions are met: 1. The uplink receive quality of the new call is smaller than or equal to "VamosIntraHoUlQualThd" minus "VamosAssUlQualThdOffset" and "VAMOSOLRXQUALOFT". 2. The downlink receive quality of the new call is smaller than or equal to "VamosIntraHoDlQualThd" minus "VamosAssUlQualThdOffset" and "VAMOSOLRXQUALOFT". 3. The uplink and downlink receive levels, ATCB, absolute value of the difference between main and diversity receive levels, and P/N criterion meet relevant requirements. 
An established call in the overlaid subcell can be used as the candidate VAMOS call if all of the following conditions are met: 1. The uplink receive quality of the established call is smaller than or equal to "VamosIntraHoUlQualThd" minus "VAMOSOLRXQUALOFT". 2. The downlink receive quality of the established call is smaller than or equal to "VamosIntraHoDlQualThd" minus "VAMOSOLRXQUALOFT". 3. The uplink and downlink receive levels, ATCB, absolute value of the difference between main and diversity receive levels, and P/N criterion meet relevant requirements. 
The actual value of this parameter equals the GUI value minus 70.
summary.impact:
The smaller the value of this parameter:
The smaller the receive signal level offset between a call in the overlaid subcell that regards as the candidate VAMOS call and a call in the underlaid subcell that regards as the candidate VAMOS call
The looser the conditions for selecting a call as the candidate VAMOS call
The more the VAMOS traffic volume
The lower the network quality.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Path Loss Offset Thres. of VAMOS Call
summary.meaning: Threshold of the absolute value of the path loss difference between two calls for VAMOS channel multiplexing. When the absolute value of the path loss difference between two calls is smaller than or equal to this threshold, the two calls are allowed to be multiplexed.
summary.impact: The larger the value of this parameter, the more VAMOS calls and the less multiplexing attempts. This affects VAMOS traffic volume and network quality.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: DL RX Bad Qual. Demultiplex Thres.
summary.meaning: Downlink receive quality threshold of a VAMOS call in channel demultiplexing due to poor speech quality in a cell. The decision of channel demultiplexing due to poor speech quality is triggered when either of the following conditions is met: 1. The downlink receive quality of a VAMOS call in a common cell or underlaid subcell of a concentric cell is greater than or equal to this threshold or the uplink receive quality is greater than or equal to " VamosQualReuseUpLinkQualThd". 2. The downlink receive quality of a VAMOS call in the overlaid subcell of a concentric cell is greater than or equal to the value of "VamosQualReuseDownLinkQualThd" minus "VAMOSDEPOLRXQUALOFT" or the uplink receive quality is greater than or equal to the value of "VamosQualReuseUpLinkQualThd" minus "VAMOSDEPOLRXQUALOFT". A call can be demultiplexed using the intra-cell handover only when the decision conditions are met for times specified by "VamosQualReuseLastTimes" within the duration specified by "VamosQualReuseStatTimes".
summary.impact: The larger the value of this parameter, the later VAMOS channel demultiplexing decision is made due to poor call quality, the smaller the number of times for handovers due to poor call quality, the heavier the VAMOS traffic in the cell, and the greater the network quality deterioration.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Bad Qual. Duration for Demultiplex
summary.meaning: Duration in which a call satisfies the conditions for channel demultiplexing due to poor speech quality in a cell. Within "Watch Time of Poor Qual. for Demultiplex", a call can be demultiplexed only when it satisfies the conditions for "Poor Qual. Duration for Demultiplex".
summary.impact: The larger the value of this parameter, the later the VAMOS channel multiplexing decision is made due to poor call quality, the heavier the VAMOS traffic in the cell, and the greater the network quality deterioration.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Watch Time of Bad Qual. for Demultiplex
summary.meaning: Duration for observing the receive quality of a VAMOS call in the decision of channel demultiplexing due to poor speech quality in a cell.
summary.impact: The larger the value of this parameter, the later the VAMOS channel multiplexing decision is made due to poor call quality, the heavier the VAMOS traffic in the cell, and the greater the network quality deterioration.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Channel Demultiplex on Bad Qual.
summary.meaning: Whether to enable VAMOS channel demultiplexing when the speech quality of a call is poor. The value ON indicates that VAMOS channel demultiplexing due to poor speech quality is enabled; the value OFF indicates that VAMOS channel demultiplexing due to poor speech quality is disabled.
summary.impact: When this parameter is set to ON and "VamosSwitch" is set to ON, VFR, or VHR, KPIs related to network quality improve.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: UL RX Bad Qual. Demultiplex Thres.
summary.meaning: Uplink receive quality threshold of a VAMOS call in channel demultiplexing due to poor speech quality in a cell. The decision of channel demultiplexing due to poor speech quality is triggered when either of the following conditions is met: 1. The uplink receive quality of a VAMOS call in a common cell or underlaid subcell of a concentric cell is greater than or equal to this threshold or the downlink receive quality is greater than or equal to "VamosQualReuseDownLinkQualThd". 2. The uplink receive quality of a VAMOS call in the overlaid subcell of a concentric cell is greater than or equal to the value of "VamosQualReuseUpLinkQualThd" minus "VAMOSDEPOLRXQUALOFT" or the downlink receive quality is greater than or equal to "VamosQualReuseDownLinkQualThd" minus "VAMOSDEPOLRXQUALOFT". A call can be demultiplexed using the intra-cell handover only when the decision conditions are met for times specified by "VamosQualReuseLastTimes" within the duration specified by "VamosQualReuseStatTimes".
summary.impact: The larger the value of this parameter, the later VAMOS channel demultiplexing decision is made due to poor call quality, the smaller the number of times for handovers due to poor call quality, the heavier the VAMOS traffic in the cell, and the greater the network quality deterioration.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: BQ VAMOS Channel Demultiplex Optimize
summary.meaning: Whether to optimize bad quality (BQ) VAMOS channel demultiplexing handovers. If this parameter is set to ON, quality-based handovers (interference, BQ and TCHF-to-TCHH handover) except BQ VAMOS channel demultiplexing handovers are not allowed for VAMOS calls. During such a handover, a call with good signal quality is handed over to another channel, whereas a call with poor signal quality cannot be handed over through any quality-based handovers during the penalty period specified by "BQ VAMOS Channel Demultiplex Penalty Period".
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to ON, only BQ VAMOS channel demultiplexing handovers among quality-based handovers are allowed for VAMOS calls. During a BQ VAMOS channel demultiplexing handover, a call with good signal quality is handed over to another channel. This increases the success rate for BQ VAMOS channel demultiplexing handovers and decreases the VAMOS call drop rate.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: BQ VAMOS Channel Demultiplex Penalty Period
summary.meaning: When VAMOS channel demultiplexing due to BQ is performed, a call with good signal quality is handed over to another channel, whereas a call with poor signal quality cannot be handed over through any quality-based handovers (interference, BQ, or TCHF/TCHH handovers). This parameter specifies the period during which quality-based handovers or VAMOS multiplexing cannot be performed on a call with poor signal quality.
summary.impact:
If this parameter is set to an overly large value: When "VamosBQDemuxPenSw" is set to OFF(Off), the number of call drops due to BQ increases, and voice quality deteriorates. When "VamosBQDemuxPenSw" is set to ON(On), VAMOS traffic decreases.
If this parameter is set to an overly small value: When "VamosBQDemuxPenSw" is set to OFF(Off), handovers are frequently performed, and the signaling load increases. When "VamosBQDemuxPenSw" is set to ON(On), the number of call drops due to VAMOS multiplexing increases.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: VAMOS Switch
summary.impact: The VAMOS function increases network capacity by sacrificing quality. As a result, when the VAMOS function is enabled, the network capacity increases and the congestion rate decreases; however, the quality-related network KPIs deteriorate.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: VAMOS TSC Automatic Mapping Switch
summary.meaning: Whether to enable the VAMOS TSC automatic mapping function. When this parameter is set to ON, the frequency hopping (FH) group training sequence code (TSC) serves as the primary TSC used by VAMOS multiplexing calls in FH mode, and the base station color code (BCC) serves as the primary TSC used by VAMOS multiplexing calls in non-FH mode. The secondary TSC in VAMOS is obtained based on its mapping relationship with the primary TSC in VAMOS. When this parameter is set to OFF, the primary and secondary TSCs used by VAMOS multiplexing calls are controlled by "VamosMainTsc" and "VamosSubTsc".
summary.impact: The values of S3281:Maximum Distance Between MS and BTS and AS3280:Mean Distance Between MS and BTS change, and the high quality indicator (HQI) may slightly decrease.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: ATCB Thld Offset for VAMOS FR Multiplexing
summary.meaning: ATCB threshold offset of the decision on candidate VAMOS FR calls from that on candidate VAMOS HR calls. The adaptive cell border (ATCB) of a non-Single Antenna Interference Cancellation (SAIC) MS that newly accesses a common cell or the underlaid subcell of a concentric cell must be greater than or equal to the sum of "VamosIntraHoNoneSaicAtcbThd", "VamosAssMultAtcbOffset", and this parameter. The ATCB of a non-SAIC MS that has accessed a common cell or the underlaid subcell of a concentric cell must be greater than or equal to the sum of "VamosIntraHoNoneSaicAtcbThd" and this parameter. The ATCB of a non-SAIC MS that newly accesses the overlaid subcell of a concentric cell must be greater than equal to the sum of "VamosIntraHoNoneSaicAtcbThd", "VamosAssMultAtcbOffset", "VamosIuoInnerAtcbThd", and this parameter. The ATCB of a non-SAIC MS that has accessed the overlaid subcell of a concentric cell must be greater than or equal to the sum of "VamosIntraHoNoneSaicAtcbThd", "VamosIuoInnerAtcbThd", and this parameter. The preceding rules apply to SAIC MSs, VAMOS I MSs, and VAMOS II MSs. The actual value of this parameter equals to the current value of this parameter minus 64. If this parameter is set to a value less than 64, the actual value is a negative value.
summary.impact: The larger the value of this parameter, the higher the ATCB of a candidate VAMOS FR call, the fewer the candidate VAMOS FR calls that meet the requirement, and the lighter the VAMOS FR traffic, decreasing the HQI and increasing the call drop rate less significantly.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: RX Quality Thld Offset for VAMOS FR Multiplex
summary.meaning:
Receive quality threshold offset for the decision on candidate VAMOS FR calls. For a call that newly accesses a common cell or the underlaid subcell of a concentric cell, the uplink receive quality must be less than or equal to the sum of this parameter and "VamosIntraHoUlQualThd" minus "VamosAssUlQualThdOffset"; and the downlink receive quality must be less than or equal to the sum of this parameter and "VamosIntraHoDlQualThd" minus "VamosAssUlQualThdOffset". 
For a call that has accessed a common cell or the underlaid subcell of a concentric cell, the uplink receive quality must be less than or equal to the sum of this parameter and "VamosIntraHoUlQualThd"; and the downlink receive quality must be less than or equal to the sum of this parameter and "VamosIntraHoDlQualThd".
For a call that newly accesses the overlaid subcell of a concentric cell, the uplink receive quality must be less than or equal to the sum of this parameter and the result of ("VamosIntraHoUlQualThd" - "VamosAssUlQualThdOffset" - "VAMOSOLRXQUALOFT"); and the downlink receive quality must be less than or equal to the sum of this parameter and the result of ("VamosIntraHoDlQualThd" - "VamosAssUlQualThdOffset" - "VAMOSOLRXQUALOFT").
For a call that has accessed the overlaid subcell of a concentric cell, the uplink receive quality must be less than or equal to the sum of this parameter and "VamosIntraHoUlQualThd" minus "VAMOSOLRXQUALOFT"; and the downlink receive quality must be less than or equal to the sum of this parameter and "VamosIntraHoDlQualThd" minus "VAMOSOLRXQUALOFT".
summary.impact: The smaller the value of this parameter, the higher the requirement on the receive quality of a candidate VAMOS FR call, the fewer the candidate VAMOS FR calls that meet the requirement, and the lighter the VAMOS FR traffic, decreasing the HQI and increasing the call drop rate less significantly.
summary.recommended: 5(to further increase the VAMOS FR traffic volume without affecting the VAMOS HR traffic volume)

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: RX Quality Thld Offset for BQ FR Demultiplexing
summary.meaning:
Receive quality threshold offset for triggering VAMOS FR channel demultiplexing due to bad quality. VAMOS FR channel demultiplexing due to bad quality is triggered if one of the following conditions is met:
1. The uplink receive quality of a VAMOS FR call in a common cell or the underlaid subcell of a concentric cell is greater than or equal to the sum of "VamosQualReuseUpLinkQualThd" and this parameter. 
2. The downlink receive quality of this call is greater than or equal to the sum of "VamosQualReuseDownLinkQualThd" and this parameter. 
3. The uplink receive quality of a VAMOS FR call in the overlaid subcell of a concentric cell is greater than or equal to the sum of this parameter and "VamosQualReuseUpLinkQualThd" minus "VAMOSDEPOLRXQUALOFT".
4. The downlink receive quality of a VAMOS FR call in the overlaid subcell of a concentric cell is greater than or equal to the sum of this parameter and "VamosQualReuseDownLinkQualThd" minus "VAMOSDEPOLRXQUALOFT".
summary.impact: The smaller the value of this parameter, the earlier the BSC triggers the decision on VAMOS FR channel demultiplexing due to uplink/downlink bad quality, and the lighter the VAMOS FR traffic. In addition, the MOS decreases and the call drop rate increases less significantly.
summary.recommended: 5(to further increase the VAMOS FR traffic volume without affecting the VAMOS HR traffic volume)

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: RX Level Thld Offset for VAMOS FR Multiplexing
summary.meaning:
Receive level threshold offset for the decision on candidate VAMOS FR calls. For a call that newly accesses a common cell or the underlaid subcell of a concentric cell, the uplink receive level must be greater than or equal to the sum of "VamosIntraHoUlRxlevThd", "VamosAssDlRxlevThdOffset", and this parameter; and the downlink receive level must be greater than or equal to the sum of "VamosIntraHoDlRxlevThd", "VamosAssDlRxlevThdOffset", and this parameter. 
For a call that has accessed a common cell or the underlaid subcell of a concentric cell, the uplink receive level must be greater than or equal to the sum of "VamosIntraHoUlRxlevThd" and this parameter; and the downlink receive level must be greater than or equal to the sum of "VamosIntraHoDlRxlevThd" and this parameter. 
For a call that newly accesses the overlaid subcell of a concentric cell, the uplink receive level must be greater than or equal to the sum of "VamosIntraHoUlRxlevThd", "VamosAssDlRxlevThdOffset", "VAMOSOLRXLEVOFT", and this parameter; and the downlink receive level must be greater than or equal to the sum of "VamosIntraHoDlRxlevThd", "VamosAssDlRxlevThdOffset", "VAMOSOLRXLEVOFT", and this parameter.
For a call that has accessed the overlaid subcell of a concentric cell, the uplink receive level must be greater than or equal to the sum of "VamosIntraHoUlRxlevThd", "VAMOSOLRXLEVOFT", and this parameter; and the downlink receive level must be greater than or equal to the sum of "VamosIntraHoDlRxlevThd", "VAMOSOLRXLEVOFT", and this parameter. 
The actual value of this parameter equals to the current value of this parameter minus 128. If this parameter is set to a value less than 128, the actual value is a negative value.
summary.impact: The larger the value of this parameter, the higher the requirement on the downlink receive level of a candidate VAMOS FR call, the fewer the candidate VAMOS FR calls that meet the requirement, and the lighter the VAMOS FR traffic, decreasing the HQI and increasing the call drop rate less significantly.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Enable VAMOS FR to HR Multiplexing Conversion
summary.meaning: Whether to allow the conversion from a VAMOS FR call to a VAMOS HR call when the network load is heavier than "VamosMultLoadThd".
summary.impact: Converting VAMOS FR calls to VAMOS HR calls increases the usage efficiency of radio resources but increases call drop risks. Setting this parameter to ON decreases the VAMOS FR traffic volume and MOS, increases the VAMOS HR traffic volume, and alleviates network congestion.

summary.mo_desc: Advanced Channel Management Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: TCH Traffic Busy Threshold
summary.meaning: If the current channel seizure ratio reaches or exceeds this value, the half-rate TCH is assigned preferentially; otherwise, the full-rate TCH is assigned preferentially.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a large value, congestion occurs in the cell during peak hours. If this parameter is set to a small value, TCHHs are allocated to MSs even if the cell load is light, deteriorating the voice quality.

summary.mo_desc: Advanced Channel Management Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: AMR TCH/H Prior Cell Load Threshold
summary.meaning: Load threshold for assigning half rate channels preferentially. If the current TCH seizure ratio of the cell is greater than or equal to this threshold, AMR half rate channels are assigned preferentially.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a large value, cell congestion cannot be relieved. If this parameter is set to a small value, TCHHs are assigned unnecessarily, affecting the voice quality.

summary.mo_desc: Advanced Channel Management Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Level Thresh for Assign BCCH Under TBCCH
summary.meaning:
During channel assignment, the assignment of channels on the BCCH TRXs depends on the uplink receive level, quality, and non-BCCH load. The TCHs are preferentially assigned on the BCCH TRXs if the following conditions are met: 
1. The uplink receive level after filtering is higher than "Level Thresh. for Assigning Main BCCH Carrier Channel Under TIGHT BCCH".
2. The uplink receive quality level after filtering is lower than "Quality Thresh. for Assigning Main BCCH Carrier Channel Under TIGHT BCCH". 
3. The Non-BCCH load is higher than "Non-BCCH Load Threshold for TIGHT BCCH HO".
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a small value, BCCHs fail to be assigned, decreasing the access success rate.

summary.mo_desc: Advanced Channel Management Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Quality Thresh for Assign BCCH Under TBCCH
summary.meaning:
During channel assignment, the assignment of channels on the BCCH TRXs depends on the uplink receive level, quality, and non-BCCH load. The TCHs are preferentially assigned on the BCCH TRXs if the following conditions are met: 
1. The uplink receive level after filtering is higher than "Level Thresh. for Assigning Main BCCH Carrier Channel Under TIGHT BCCH".
2. The uplink receive quality level after filtering is lower than "Quality Thresh. for Assigning Main BCCH Carrier Channel Under TIGHT BCCH". 
3. The Non-BCCH load is higher than "Non-BCCH Load Threshold for TIGHT BCCH HO".
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to a large value, BCCHs fail to be assigned, decreasing the access success rate.

summary.mo_desc: Basic Channel Management Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: TIGHT BCCH Switch
summary.meaning: Whether to enable the BCCH aggressive frequency reuse algorithm
summary.impact: None

summary.mo_desc: Advanced Handover Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Non-BCCH Load Threshold for TIGHT BCCH HO
summary.meaning:
If the load on the non-BCCH TRX is less than the value of "TIGHTBCCHHOLOADTHRES" when the BSC decides whether to trigger a TIGHT BCCH handover, the BSC does not trigger a handover.
During channel assignment, the assignment of channels on the BCCH TRXs depends on the uplink receive level, quality, and non-BCCH load. The TCHs are preferentially assigned on the BCCH TRXs if the following conditions are met: 
1. The uplink receive level after filtering is higher than "Level Thresh. for Assigning Main BCCH Carrier Channel Under TIGHT BCCH". 
2. The uplink receive quality level after filtering is lower than "Quality Thresh. for Assigning Main BCCH Carrier Channel Under TIGHT BCCH". 
3. The Non-BCCH load is higher than "Non-BCCH Load Threshold for TIGHT BCCH HO".
summary.impact: None

summary.mo_desc: GSM Cell at BSC
summary.pname: Cell LAC
summary.meaning:
Location area code (LAC). An MS can move freely in a location area with no need of location update. Appropriate division of location areas can effectively lighten the signaling load and improve the call completion rate.
The LAC is a 2-byte hexadecimal code. It ranges from 0000 to FFFF(ffff). The codes 0000 and FFFE(fffe) are reserved. Only the LMT supports hexadecimal codes. The hexadecimal format is H'**** or h'****, for example, H'1214 or h'1214.
summary.impact: None
summary.kpi: HO / identity (can cause HO fail & drop)

summary.mo_desc: Extended Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Reserved TCH Number for PA Turning On
summary.meaning: This parameter specifies the number of idle channels that should be reserved on a cell after the TRX is shut down. When the number of idle channels on a cell is less than or equal to this threshold, the BSC enables a TRX. This parameter is used to prevent the impact enabling or disabling delay on the efficiency of channel assignment on the cell that is enabled with the TRX Intelligent Shutdown feature. The value of this parameter represents the number of TCHFs and is used after being converted to the number of TCHHs. For example, if this parameter is set to 1, two idle TCHHs are reserved for the cell.
summary.impact: None

summary.mo_desc: Parameters for Dynamically Turning off Cell
summary.pname: Dyn. Turning Off Cell Stop Time
summary.meaning: End time for dynamically disabling a cell. A cell is not allowed to be disabled from the time specified by this parameter. When the value of "TURNOFFCELLSTPTIME" is less than the value of "TURNOFFCELLSTRTIME", the Dynamic Cell Power Off feature can be enabled for more than a day. When the value of "TURNOFFCELLSTPTIME" is equal to the value of "TURNOFFCELLSTRTIME", the Dynamic Cell Power Off feature can be enabled all day.
summary.impact: None

summary.mo_desc: Parameters for Dynamically Turning off Cell
summary.pname: Joint Co-Coverage Level Threshold
summary.meaning: Threshold for determining whether a neighboring cell meets the co-coverage condition. If the level of the neighboring cell is greater than or equal to this threshold in the measurement report, the neighboring cell meets the co-coverage condition.
summary.impact: None

summary.mo_desc: Parameters for Dynamically Turning off Cell
summary.pname: Joint Co-Coverage Ratio Threshold
summary.meaning: Threshold for determining whether a serving cell can be disabled. If the proportion of measurement reports indicating that neighboring cells meet the joint co-coverage level threshold condition in all measurement reports is greater than or equal to the value of this parameter, the serving cell can be disabled.
summary.impact: None

summary.mo_desc: Parameters for Dynamically Turning off Cell
summary.pname: Low Band Joint Turn-off Switch
summary.meaning: Whether to enable joint turning-off for a low-band cell. If this parameter is set to ON, the low-band cell (for example, on the 900 MHz band) can be jointly turned off. If this parameter is set to OFF, joint turning-off is not allowed for the low-band cell.
summary.impact: Some low-band cells may be shut down if this parameter is set to ON.
