As a result, the network coverage in the corresponding area may deteriorate, causing traffic volume decrease and deterioration of KPIs such as the paging success rate, access success rate, handover success rate, and call drop rate.

summary.mo_desc: Parameters for Dynamically Turning off Cell
summary.pname: Preferentially Turn Off BCCH TRX Switch
summary.meaning: Whether to enable the preferential BCCH TRX shutdown function in the Dynamic Cell Power Off feature. When this parameter is set to ON(On), and conditions for triggering Dynamic Cell Power Off are met, if the BCCH TRX is idle, the BSC preferentially shuts down the BCCH TRX no matter whether other TRXs are occupied. If the BCCH TRX is not idle, the BSC initiates outgoing cell handovers or intra-cell handovers to other TRXs for calls carried on the BCCH TRX and then preferentially shuts down the BCCH TRX. When this parameter is set to OFF(Off), the function does not take effect.
summary.impact: If the cell outgoing handover success rate is low, setting this parameter to ON(On) increases the immediate assignment success rate, and setting this parameter to OFF(Off) decreases the immediate assignment success rate.

summary.mo_desc: Parameters for Dynamically Turning off Cell
summary.pname: Same Coverage Cell No
summary.meaning: Index of a cell that has the same coverage as the current cell.
summary.impact: The coverage area of co-coverage cells must cover the current cell, which is enabled with the Dynamic Cell Power Off feature. If the planning is incorrect, the current cell may be shut down mistakenly. As a result, the network coverage in the corresponding area may deteriorate, causing traffic volume decrease and deterioration of KPIs such as the paging success rate, access success rate, handover success rate, and call drop rate.

summary.mo_desc: Parameters for Dynamically Turning off Cell
summary.pname: Enable Turning Off Cell
summary.meaning: Whether to enable the Dynamic Cell Power Off feature. When this parameter is set to ENABLE, the BSC can disable the cell within the period of time specified by "TURNOFFCELLSTRTIME" and" TURNOFFCELLSTPTIME". When this parameter is set to DISABLE, the BSC will never disable the cell. When this parameter is set to SLEEPING, the BSC will disable the cell unconditionally within "TURNOFFCELLSTRTIME" and "TURNOFFCELLSTPTIME" and keep the cell unconditionally enabled during other time. If the value of this parameter is changed to SLEEPING or changed from SLEEPING to other values for a cell, the new setting takes effect five minutes later. When this parameter is set to AUTOCOTURNOFF, the system automatically identifies and configures co-coverage cells without the need of manual identification and configuration and disables the cell when load conditions are met in the specified time period.
summary.impact: None

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Auto Mute SAIC Identification Switch
summary.meaning: Whether to enable automatic identification of mute SAIC-capable MSs in a cell. A mute SAIC-capable MS is a SAIC-capable MS that is reported as SAIC-incapable. The value ON indicates that automatic identification of such MSs is enabled; the value OFF indicates that automatic identification of such MSs is disabled.
summary.impact: When this parameter is set to ON, the downlink DTX, TFO, and local switching functions will be disabled if either of the following conditions is met: 1. "SpeMsIdeMutexOpt" is set to OFF.2. "SpeMsIdeMutexOpt" is set to ON and the current call is processed on a half-rate channel. Disabling these functions in the preceding scenario affects network interference. If the Alpha-QPSK modulation is used on the downlink, the downlink receive quality will deteriorate during the call.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Faulty SAIC MS Alpha Hop Modulate Period
summary.meaning: Period of Alpha hopping modulation during VAMOS multiplexing on a SAIC-capable MS with AFC defects or during the identification of such MSs.
summary.impact: None

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Faulty SAIC MS Alpha Hop Modulate Value
summary.meaning: Alpha value used for Alpha hopping modulation during VAMOS multiplexing on a SAIC-capable MS with AFC defects or during the identification of such MSs.
summary.impact: When the VAMOS Call Drop Solution feature is enabled, problem SAIC MSs use alpha hopping modulation after VAMOS channel multiplexing. The call drop solution capability varies by alpha. Therefore, changing the value of this parameter affects the call drop rate and number of call drops.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Problem SAIC Terminal Identify Switch
summary.meaning: Whether to enable automatic identification of SAIC-capable MSs with AFC defects in a cell.
summary.impact: When this parameter is set to ON(On), downlink DTX, TFO, and local switching will be disabled if either of the following conditions is met: 1. "SpeMsIdeMutexOpt" is set to OFF(Off). 2. "SpeMsIdeMutexOpt" is set to ON(On) and the current call is processed on a half-rate channel. Disabling these functions in the preceding scenario affects network interference. When alpha hopping modulation is used on the downlink, the downlink receive quality will deteriorate during the call.

summary.mo_desc: VAMOS Channel Multiplex Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Allow Multiplex for Unknown SAIC MS
summary.meaning:
Whether to allow VAMOS multiplexing for an identified SAIC-capable MS with possible AFC defects.
When this parameter is set to ON, VAMOS multiplexing is allowed for such an MS and Alpha hopping modulation is required.
When this parameter is set to OFF, VAMOS multiplexing is not allowed for such an MS.
summary.impact: If this parameter is set to ON, the call drop rate increases after VAMOS multiplexing is used. If this parameter is set to OFF, the VAMOS multiplexing rate decreases.

summary.mo_desc: GSM Cell at BSC
summary.pname: Active Status
summary.meaning: This parameter specifies whether the cell is active.
summary.impact: None

summary.mo_desc: Parameters for Dynamically Turning off Cell
summary.pname: Dyn. Turning Off Cell Start Time
summary.meaning: Start time for dynamically disabling a cell. A cell is allowed to be disabled from the time specified by this parameter. When the value of "TURNOFFCELLSTPTIME" is less than the value of "TURNOFFCELLSTRTIME", the Dynamic Cell Power Off feature can be enabled for more than a day. When the value of "TURNOFFCELLSTPTIME" is equal to the value of "TURNOFFCELLSTRTIME", the Dynamic Cell Power Off feature can be enabled all day.
summary.impact: None

summary.mo_desc: Basic Handover Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: SRVCC Handover Allowed
summary.meaning: This parameter indicates whether the SRVCC handover is supported. If this parameter is set to "YES", the speech call handled by the IMS can be handed over a GSM cell. In this manner, the continuity of the speech service is maintained.
summary.impact: None

summary.mo_desc: Basic Parameters of Cell
summary.pname: Max TA
summary.meaning: This parameter specifies the actual coverage area of a cell. After receiving the channel request message, the BTS determines whether the channel assignment is performed in the cell by comparing the TA and the value of this parameter. The value of this parameter is determined by that of "Cell Extension Type" in the "ADD GCELL" command.
summary.impact: None

summary.mo_desc: Parameters for Dynamically Turning off Cell
summary.pname: Same Coverage Cell Load Threshold
summary.meaning: A cell can be disabled only if the load of the co-coverage cell is lower than the threshold specified by this parameter for a period.
summary.impact: None

summary.mo_desc: Parameters for Dynamically Turning off Cell
summary.pname: Dyn. Turning On Cell Load Threshold
summary.meaning: When the load of the same coverage cell is higher than or equal to this threshold for a period, the disabled cell is enabled.
summary.impact: None
